defective_pattern: Validation scripts and agents issuing a 'PASS' on regression deliverables by only verifying typography, XML tags, and numerical existence, while failing to assert the mandatory 3-Table structure per regression model.
why_defective: Allows incomplete, consolidated single-table regression reports to slip past the QA release gate without detecting the absence of ANOVA sum-of-squares decomposition, residual degrees of freedom, and collinearity diagnostic columns.
observed_symptoms: Validator reports PASS on consolidated 1-table regressions
User intervenes to report missing 3-table structure
corrective_remedy: Implement mandatory fail-closed assertion in validator: every regression hypothesis deliverable MUST contain Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (Model Summary & Combined ANOVA with 11 columns), and Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity with 8 columns). If any table or column is missing, the validator MUST emit verdict: FAIL.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Assert presence of (table_1_correlations, table_2_model_summary_anova, table_3_coefficients) in JSON and corresponding 3 tables in MD/DOCX for every regression model.
